about: Pairs of claims about a stay (a trip, a visit, a contract, a foster, an interim role) stated first (older) and later (newer) by the same source, for the rung 2.5 update probe, read_update_slot with its reported-change rule and its second reading. 'class' groups the rows: 'temporary-to-permanent' is a bounded stay that the newer claim reports has become lasting at the same place or with the same party (the move or change has happened); 'decided-not-ended' is a bounded stay against a decision, an acceptance or a plan to make it lasting, which leaves the stay possibly still under way; 'same-place-non-update' adds detail, restates, or names a different attribute or a lasting tie of the same place or party that is not the stay; 'lasting-then-temporary' is a lasting value followed by a bounded stay or role, at another place or the same one, which must not replace it, under the probe's rule that a lasting value and a statement limited to a period fill different slots; 'anchor-update' is a plain change of residence, the case the probe already handles; 'temporary-ended' is a bounded stay the newer claim reports over (a return home); 'renewed-bound' is a bounded arrangement given a new bound. 'expected' is 'changes' when the newer claim should retire the older one at rung 2.5, 'not_changes' when it should not, and 'report' for a row measured and reported but outside the record's bars (the return home is a later record's; the renewed bound's label is undecided). The first two rows are the trip case's own wordings: row trip-move-run2 is the pair the 2026-10-12 run on claude-sonnet-5-5 declined, and row trip-move-short the shorter extraction of the claude-sonnet-4-6 runs. Bar: each barred row's label matched in at least two of three samples, and no 'changes' on any not_changes row. The held-out set registered beside it is stay_pairs_heldout.json.
labelled_by: proposed on 2026-10-11 by the session that measured it; revised 2026-10-12 after the review brief on PR #815: trip-for-good and visiting-mit relabelled not_changes (a decision or acceptance does not end a stay still under way), trip-back-home made report-only, and the rows trip-owns-flat, trip-company-hq, trip-plans-move, fulltime-secondment, lead-interim-head and contract-extended added. The owner confirmed every label on 2026-10-12, and moved resident-this-week into the lasting-then-temporary class beside the held-out set's valencia-repaint.
